name: maplibre-image-plugins
description: Animated style image plugins for MapLibre GL JS

scripts.test: npm run test-tsc && npm run test-eslint && npm run test-prettier
scripts.build-site: rm -rf docs/plugins.mjs docs/chunks docs/vendor && mkdir -p docs/vendor && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:maplibre-gl --splitting --outdir=docs --entry-names=plugins --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --out-extension:.js=.mjs && cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker-dev.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css node_modules/tweakpane/dist/tweakpane.min.js docs/vendor/
